notes.title: Demo Major UI Overhaul + New Card Type
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580030/f4f7d9747d6c6a2b9305882fb19ef60ffab9f57a.png"][/img][/p][p]In this patch, the main Mission UI has received a major overhaul to focus more of the information in centralized locations. Additionally, cards have more robust descriptions and planets have intuitive tooltips to let you strategize and deploy your crew most optimally. [/p][p][/p][p]A new strange Alien Vendor is now available to be visited from the overworld. This friendly fella will provide you with powerful enhancements to improve a card of your choosing for the remainder of the run. One example is Airlock, which prevents a card from being discarded at the end of the day. These enhancements open up new strategies and possibilities, so go ahead and try to break stuff!

A level-up system has been implemented to allow unlocking new captains, cards, and relics. A few new cards have snuck their way in as well![/p][p][/p][p]This will be the last major update before the release in Fall, hope you enjoy![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580030/09396591919c2afc8c3b1702a60fd5336a29f6b6.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Negative Space Demo is live!
notes.notes:
The demo is now live! It contains over 60 cards, more than 30 trinkets, and 3 playable Captains. The full release will be coming later this year, but hopefully the demo can give you a taste for what the full game will be like. 

Enjoy and please let me know if you have any feedback!
